name: @projexlight/sdk-audit
summary: Append-only, hash-chained per-tenant audit ledger. Every state change in every other SDK calls emitEvent here; entries are SHA-256 chained so any single-row tamper breaks verification. Daily regional rollups + per-tenant chain-head signing + export-request flow back the compliance attestation story for SOC2 / HIPAA / FedRAMP / GDPR-DSAR.

endpoints.description: Append an entry to the calling tenant's chain. Most callers don't hit this directly — they call emitEvent() from this SDK which routes through it.
Walk a tenant's chain since the last attested checkpoint; recompute hashes; return chain_intact:true or the offending entry_id.

events.name: audit.entry.appended.v1
events.description: An entry was committed to a tenant's chain; carries entry_id + seq + chain_hash.

events.name: audit.chain.verified.v1
events.description: Verifier walked the chain end-to-end; chain_intact result + verified_at.

events.name: audit.chain.broken.v1
events.description: Hash mismatch detected — fires only on tamper. Triggers operator page + sovereign-region holds.

events.name: audit.export.requested.v1
events.description: Tenant admin requested a GDPR/SOC2-style audit export.

events.name: audit.export.completed.v1
events.description: Export bundle ready for download; signed by the regional chain-head key.

events.name: audit.regional.rollup.computed.v1
events.description: Daily aggregation done for a region; powers the operator dashboard counts.

models.description: Single immutable audit entry. Columns: tenant_id, seq, actor_kind, actor_id, action, subject_kind, subject_id, payload, occurred_at, chain_hash, prev_hash. Append-only — no UPDATE ever.
Latest hash per tenant; used to attach the next entry without scanning the whole chain.
Per-region daily counts; supports the operator dashboard + capacity planning.
GDPR Art-15 / SOC2 evidence-request bundles; tracks status (requested → exporting → signed → expired).

hooks.name: emitEvent
hooks.description: The universal write surface every other SDK uses. Takes { event_type, payload, actor_kind, actor_id, tenant_id, subject_kind, subject_id, pool_index } and appends to the calling tenant's chain. Idempotent on (tenant_id, idempotency_key).

hooks.name: verifyChain
hooks.description: Synchronous verifier — pass a tenant_id and it walks every entry since the last verified checkpoint, recomputing hashes. Returns { ok, broken_at_entry_id? }.

hooks.name: startAuditVerifier
hooks.description: Background worker that runs verifyChain on a rotating tenant set on the AUDIT_VERIFIER_INTERVAL_MS cadence (default daily). Fires audit.chain.broken.v1 on any mismatch.

scenarios.title: Emit an audit event from inside another SDK (the universal pattern)
scenarios.when_to_use: Every state change in every SDK does this. Tenant created? emitEvent. Key rotated? emitEvent. Invoice finalized? emitEvent. The audit chain is non-negotiable.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Appends one row to audit.entry for the calling tenant with chain_hash = sha256(prev_hash || payload). Updates audit.chain_head atomically. Returns { entry_id, seq, chain_hash }.

scenarios.title: Compliance attestation — verify a tenant's chain integrity
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer asks for a SOC2 evidence bundle; operator clicks Verify on the Audit page in projexcloud-admin; an external auditor wants a chain attestation.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Walks every entry since since_seq, recomputes hash chain, returns { ok: true } or { ok: false, broken_at_entry_id }. Emits audit.chain.verified.v1 (or audit.chain.broken.v1 on failure).

scenarios.title: Background verifier rotates through tenants daily
scenarios.when_to_use: Production deployment. Catches silent tamper attempts within 24 hours rather than waiting for a customer-driven verify request.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Worker picks tenants in round-robin order, calls verifyChain, emits the result event. Any audit.chain.broken.v1 fires a high-severity page + halts new appends on that tenant until cleared.

scenarios.title: GDPR Art-15 subject-access-request audit export
scenarios.when_to_use: Customer's end-user files a DSAR; we need a signed bundle of every audit entry mentioning their subject_id.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Worker assembles the bundle, signs it with the regional chain-head key, stores in S3 with a 7-day TTL. Emits audit.export.requested.v1 then .completed.v1. Tenant admin sees status in the Audit page.

scenarios.title: Operator reconstructs an incident from the chain
scenarios.when_to_use: Post-incident: 'show me everything actor X did between T1 and T2 in tenant Y.'
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns matching entries in seq order. UI in projexcloud-admin /audit page calls this; the per-row chain_hash lets the operator independently re-verify the slice.

compliance_posture.notes: Append-only enforcement at the DB layer via revoked UPDATE/DELETE grants — application-layer code cannot UPDATE even if it wanted to. SHA-256 chain rolls forward atomically with the entry insert in a single transaction. Regional rollups + chain-head signing satisfy the 'attestation' clause in SOC2 CC7.2. Storage retention: 7 years default (configurable per regime).

per chain verify call; background verifier does not bill
